info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Create Banking Knowledge Assets Intellectual Property Portfolio-v5-spec
info.description: The Banking Knowledge Assets Management API enables organizations to create and manage their intellectual property portfolios related to banking knowledge. This API facilitates the submission of detailed information about banking innovations, ensuring that critical knowledge assets are documented and protected. Typical consumers of this API include financial institutions and innovation teams focused on leveraging banking expertise. By using this API, businesses can efficiently track and manage their intellectual property, enhancing their competitive advantage in the market.

post.summary: Create a new intellectual property portfolio.
post.description: This operation allows you to create a new intellectual property portfolio within the knowledge assets. Provide the necessary details in the request to successfully generate a portfolio that can be managed and referenced for further actions.
